howto: Your blue ball stands in the middle of a cave floor.
A red strip flashes on the floor where a spike is about to pop up.
If it flashes under you, tap (or press Space or Up) to jump over it.
tips: Only spikes under your ball can hit you; ignore the rest.
Jumping too early is as bad as too late: the spike stays up until it sinks back into the floor.
Clearing a spike's tip by a hair counts as a Near Miss.
Spikes come faster the more you dodge.

controls.keyboard: Space or Up arrow to jump. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap anywhere to jump. Pause button top left.

difficulty: Easy gives a longer warning flash and fewer spikes; Hard a short flash and more spikes. Spikes speed up as your dodge count grows.

cheats.effect: Half gravity: every jump floats twice as long
A shield that absorbs 3 spike hits

features.one-tap-start: Tap or press Space on the title card
features.instant-restart: Tap once on the HIT! or SURVIVED! card
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card; replay from Pause > How to play
features.results: HIT! / SURVIVED! card with dodges, near misses and best
